blocks.p: Each column of the *Character* and *World* windows shows its items as a list or as a grid. The two buttons at the right of its header choose the view; the one in use is solid in the accent color.

In the list, each item has a row of its own: its picture and its name, then its category, its condition or how full it is, and its weight, under the column heads *Name*, *Cat*, *Cond / Amt* and *Wt*. Click a column head to sort the list by it. Items that stack show as one row with their count. Figure 20-1 shows the inventory of the *Character* window as a list, sorted by name, with the list button lit.
With a controller, click the left stick in a window to sort the list, and the right stick to switch between the list and the grid.

marks.text: Press the list button for one row per item, with its category, condition and weight.

blocks.p: To see the items of a column as pictures, click the grid button in its header. Each column has its own pair of buttons and keeps its own view. Figure 20-2 shows the inventory as a grid.

In the grid, each item is a picture, and the items are grouped under a heading for their category, with the count beside it, such as *Food (3)*. The weight of the item is printed in the top right corner of its picture, and its condition is the bar below. A number at the bottom right of a picture is the count of a stack. To go back to the list, click the list button.

marks.text: Press the grid button for a picture of each item, with its weight and condition.
Each picture carries the item's weight in its corner and its condition below.

sticky.text: Grid: a picture of each item.
